name: colbin
description: A columnar binary format for tabular JSON — decode to objects in the browser without JSON text in the middle

scripts.wasm: bun run wasm:lean && bun run wasm:inspect
scripts.wasm:lean: mkdir -p build && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path ../rust/wasm/Cargo.toml && cp ../rust/wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/colbin_wasm.wasm build/colbin.wasm && node scripts/optimize.mjs colbin.wasm
scripts.wasm:inspect: mkdir -p build && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path ../rust/wasm/Cargo.toml --features inspect && cp ../rust/wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/colbin_wasm.wasm build/colbin.inspect.wasm && node scripts/optimize.mjs colbin.inspect.wasm
scripts.dist: bun run inline && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp build/colbin.wasm build/colbin.inspect.wasm dist/ && cp ../LICENSE LICENSE
scripts.build: bun run wasm && bun run dist
scripts.test: bun run vectors && bun run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/tarball.mjs && bun run emit
